qualification.details: Master's degree in Library Science / Information Science / Documentation with at least 55% marks or its equivalent grade of B in the UGC seven-point scale and consistently good academic record set out in appropriate UGC regulations. Minimum of 18 years of post-qualification experience in reputed Libraries as College Librarian / Assistant Librarian OR at least 13 years of experience as a Deputy Librarian or equivalent in Pay Matrix Level 12 in a reputed Institution or University. Evidence of innovative library service and organization of published work. Desirable: M. Phil / Ph. D. degree in Library Science/Information Science / Documentation / Archives and Manuscript keeping, Computerization of Library.

content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IIT Kharagpur Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: IIT Kharagpur Librarian Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Master's degree in Library Science / Information Science / Documentation with at least 55% marks or its equivalent grade of B in the UGC seven-point scale and consistently good academic record set out in appropriate UGC regulations. Minimum of 18 years of post-qualification experience in reputed Libraries as College Librarian / Assistant Librarian OR at least 13 years of experience as a Deputy Librarian or equivalent in Pay Matrix Level 12 in a reputed Institution or University. Evidence of innovative library service and organization of published work. Desirable: M. Phil / Ph. D. degree in Library Science/Information Science / Documentation / Archives and Manuscript keeping, Computerization of Library.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Kharagpur Librarian Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 17-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Kharagpur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kharagpur Librarian recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the IIT Kharagpur Librarian position is 17 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Librarian post?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in Library Science/Information Science/Documentation with at least 55% marks and significant post-qualification experience is required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the Librarian position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Librarian post is 57 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Librarian role?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Level 14 of the Pay Matrix, ranging from ₹144200 to ₹218200 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Librarian post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Librarian post at IIT Kharagpur.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC candidates is Rs. 1000/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Librarian recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Screening Test, Written Test, Presentation, Group Discussion, and Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age relaxation for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Age relaxation details are not explicitly mentioned in the provided summary but are generally applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply offline for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, applications must be submitted online through the official IIT Kharagpur website.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link will be available in the "Important Links" section of this article.
